description: Default weaver adapter: existing stage5/stage6 Python tools plus the real stage7 RTMPS bridge. No Makefile target names are hardcoded here; every command is a configurable template. bridge_run needs MUSIKALISCHES_RTMP_URL in the environment; use weaver_dry_run_adapter.json for a keyless dry run.

stage5_audio.description: Allocate a unique combination from the persistent stage5 ledger and render audio.

stage6_stub.description: Derive the stage6 visual stub from the stage5 analyzer artifacts.

stage6_video.description: Render the offline video preview for the asset.

bridge_build.description: Freeze the stage7 bridge contract for this asset (local, no ingest credentials).

bridge_run.description: Hand the asset to the stage7 runtime in once mode (existing behaviour: one finite pass, exit at EOF).
